settings.question: When will I be charged?
settings.answer: You pay for your first gel at checkout. After that, you're billed automatically at the subscriber price each time a delivery is due – every 4 weeks by default, or every 6 or 8 if you've chosen that.

settings.question: How do I pause, skip or reschedule?
settings.answer: Log in to your subscription account – we'll email your login details when your first order is placed. From there you can pause, skip your next order, move it to a new date or change how often it arrives.

settings.question: Which frequency should I choose?
settings.answer: Most people start with every 4 weeks. If gel starts piling up, switch to 6 or 8 weeks from your account – it takes seconds.

settings.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
settings.answer: No. You can cancel at any time from your account, and you won't be charged again.

settings.question: Can I subscribe to both Ice and Hot?
settings.answer: Yes – set up a subscription for each gel and you'll get 10% off both.
